summary: Raw marketplace baseline: functional PASS in 69.1 minutes, with 12 native tests and 28 rules markers passing; test-owned cleanup verified its declared metadata scope.
Requested subject was Terra 6.1 xhigh; served-model identity and dollar cost were unavailable. This run is not a comparative efficiency result.
The explicit code-knowledge review found useful structure and error handling, partial rationale/contract coverage, and no established need for a tombstone.
The independent judge supported the omitted reusable-test definitions and disputed one planning-parser explanation. Both findings remain investigations, with no generic implementation admitted.

Authenticated UI acceptance and four missing completion receipts remain unproven. A separate apparatus interpretation now recognizes eight existing step-proof receipts and preserves those four warnings.
Keep the accepted ShipLoop baseline, retain the learning, and rerun raw chess using the repaired measurement and explicit review criterion.

chess-baseline-code-knowledge.title: Code knowledge was assessed; rationale and contract gaps remain
chess-baseline-code-knowledge.expected: Code craft retains useful contracts, error behavior, and explanations of consequential non-obvious decisions; tombstones apply only when a tempting rejected approach could return.
chess-baseline-code-knowledge.observed: The fresh review found adequate structure for exercised behavior, domain errors and UI failure cleanup. It found incomplete nearby rationale for make/unmake and cache-copy invariants and broad malformed-FEN contract claims that were not fully substantiated. No executed malformed-FEN failure, warranted missing tombstone or stale warning was established.
chess-baseline-code-knowledge.advice: Use the explicit code-knowledge lens on the rerun and retain concrete sufficiency judgments. Do not add comments or tombstones by count, and do not infer a generic prompt defect from one minor rationale gap.

chess-baseline-portable-tests.title: Four reusable local checks were omitted from the delivered repository
chess-baseline-portable-tests.expected: Reusable product-owned test definitions and portable invocation instructions survive repository return under S-11.
chess-baseline-portable-tests.observed: The delivered environment invokes four absolute run-scratch scripts and explicitly says they are not portable. The 18-file delivered tree contains none of those scripts; the retained board script includes error and contrast regressions. The independent judge supports the omission; no implementation candidate is admitted.
chess-baseline-portable-tests.advice: Investigate the existing authoring-to-return handoff with a cold restore and neutral controls before choosing a generic repair. Preserve disposable probes and maintained external test packages as distinct cases.

chess-baseline-ui-open.title: Authenticated interactive acceptance is still unverified
chess-baseline-ui-open.expected: A fidelity pass requires the existing deferred-acceptance obligations to be settled by evidence under S-9 and S-14.
chess-baseline-ui-open.observed: All four outer checks passed, including 12 Apex tests and 28 rules markers. The handoff still records authenticated board interaction and app access as unverified. This is a functional pass, not full fidelity acceptance.
chess-baseline-ui-open.advice: Keep the functional pass and open interactive acceptance separate. A subsequent UI observation must have its own declared setup and cannot retroactively change this run.

chess-baseline-planning-cause.title: Two planning send-backs occurred; one proposed cause was disputed
chess-baseline-planning-cause.expected: Reviewed plans distinguish source inspections, deployment proof and executable test reporting without requiring future behavior to pass early.
chess-baseline-planning-cause.observed: The review records two send-backs and 657.079 seconds from the second send-back to the interrupted step. The judge reproduced the navigation output through the shipped named-ID fallback and disputed the claimed reporting incompatibility. Recovery time is observed, not promised savings.
chess-baseline-planning-cause.advice: Investigate the source-search mismatch and remaining coverage question while retaining the judge counterexample. Do not turn the disproven parser explanation into a prompt or script change.

chess-code-knowledge-rerun.title: Assess code knowledge on the next full run
chess-code-knowledge-rerun.goal: Do: run the existing raw chess loop and obtain the explicit code-knowledge review and fresh judge. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/review.py QUESTIONS and the next retained run. Test: existing chess E2E case plus fresh review and judge. Done when: code structure, contracts, error paths, rationale and warranted tombstones each have evidence or an explicit limit.
chess-code-knowledge-rerun.why: The owner requested these sufficiency judgments; this measures review coverage without inventing a comment quota.

chess-portable-cold-restore.title: Reproduce the portable-suite gap before choosing a repair
chess-portable-cold-restore.goal: Do: inspect a cold delivery where the original run scratch directory is unavailable and distinguish reusable tests from disposable probes and maintained external packages. Files and symbols: the retained delivery/work.bundle and docs/shiploop/environment.md. Test: attempt the documented local suite in that isolated copy and retain its terminal result. Done when: the missing dependencies and the narrowest warranted handoff change are demonstrated or refuted.
chess-portable-cold-restore.why: The omission is independently supported; the best generic correction is not yet validated.

chess-ui-retain-limit.title: Preserve the interactive acceptance limit in this baseline
chess-ui-retain-limit.goal: Do: retain the original functional result and the two open interactive acceptance entries without a fidelity-pass claim. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/LEARNINGS.md and this run review. Test: none; this records a known limit. Done when: the retained learning distinguishes the passed checks from unobserved interactive behavior.
chess-ui-retain-limit.why: The original case did not declare a browser; adding evidence later would be a separate observation.

chess-planning-investigate.title: Use the counterexample in the planning investigation
chess-planning-investigate.goal: Do: compare source-search, deployment-proof and custom-runner planning examples against the shipped verifier, preserving its named-ID fallback. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/learning-records.jsonl and skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_test_loop.py. Test: neutral command-output probes including the judge counterexample. Done when: a specific remaining compatibility or coverage gap is supported without treating all custom runners as invalid.
chess-planning-investigate.why: The judge directly contradicted part of the initial explanation, so that explanation cannot justify a change.
